title: From AutoResearch to Continual AutoResearch: Do Agents Learn Across Tasks?
first_author_affiliation: RBC Borealis / ELLIS Institute Tübingen / Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems
code_status: 原文未提供可确认作者源码仓库，本轮未找到/未确认公开代码；引用karpathy/autoresearch不等于本文实现开源。

cost_assessment.available_resource: one NVIDIA A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.model_scale: five frontier CLI agents with persistent/reset and memory ablations
cost_assessment.data_scale: nine task families; 32 transfer tasks per agent; 15/30/60-minute budget studies and repeated paired runs
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Published full configuration and task budgets, not locally measured; repeated real-model/agent runs exceed this bounded single-device batch.
cost_assessment.decision: 多模型、多任务流、分钟至小时级真实研究对照成本过高，不复现（审查DONE）；仅执行CPU运行后评分与匹配协议。

summary: 在相同任务流、模型、数据和时间预算下比较持续与重置Agent，分别度量首解质量、运行后hidden-test最优曲线面积和最终选择效果，避免把更早找到解误报为更强最终能力。
fidelity_note: 只实现closed-run离线评分、训练SD归一化、首解/最终选择/最优曲线AUC/选择遗憾及排除第一任务的配对聚合；不运行自主研究Agent，不把隐藏分数反馈给在线actor。
